Powiazania: ListBlocks->SaveAs->Foreach(TargetVariable)->InsertBlock, CreateBlock->InsertBlock, EditBlock->InsertBlock, EditAttributes->InsertBlock, SelectEntities->InsertBlock. Wymaga CadBlocksProfile.
